text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon waking, Rhein Kraft recovered 
rapidly. Convinced that her running would 
leave an impact on someone, she devoted 
herself to training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She then makes a vow to Daring Heart, who 
won't be running in the Sprinters Stakes: 
she will do her very best for the sake of 
the person who accepted her for who she 
is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes is here. To become an 
inspiration to everyone, she challenges 
her senior Tiara Umamusume.
